mapper.sql: AUTHENTICATION_LOG_IDX, HOMEPAGE_ID, USER_NAME, USER_BIRTH, USER_IP, (SELECT HOMEPAGE_NAME FROM CMS_HOMEPAGE WHERE HOMEPAGE_ID = AUTHENTICATION_LOG.HOMEPAGE_ID) as HOMEPAGE_NAME, CASE WHEN HOMEPAGE_TYPE = 1 THEN '홈페이지' WHEN HOMEPAGE_TYPE = 2 THEN '검색대' ELSE '기타' END AS HOMEPAGE_TYPE_NAME, USER_PHONE, HOMEPAGE_TYPE, SUCCESS_TYPE, RESULT_MESSAGE, CERT_TYPE, USER_AGENT, BROWSER_TYPE, ADD_DATE

choose.when: AND ADD_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 - INTERVAL '1' SECOND
AND ADD_DATE BETWEEN TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{startMonthYear}, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY') AND LAST_DAY(TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{startMonthYear}, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY') + INTERVAL '11' MONTH)
AND ADD_DATE BETWEEN TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{startYear}, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY') AND TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{endYear}, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY') + INTERVAL '1' YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY
choose.otherwise: AND ADD_DATE BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUTHENTICATION_LOG(AUTHENTICATION_LOG_IDX, HOMEPAGE_ID, USER_NAME, USER_BIRTH, USER_IP, USER_PHONE, HOMEPAGE_TYPE, SUCCESS_TYPE, RESULT_MESSAGE, CERT_TYPE, USER_AGENT, BROWSER_TYPE, ADD_DATE) VALUES (AUTHENTICATIONLOG_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{auth_homepage_id}, #{member_name}, #{birth_day}, #{auth_remote_ip}, #{auth_cell_phone}, #{auth_homepage_type}, #{sci_result}, #{auth_message}, #{certType}, #{auth_remote_agent}, #{auth_browser_type}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select:
WITH date_series AS ( SELECT
TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + LEVEL - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{startMonthYear} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM'), LEVEL - 1), 'YYYY-MM')
TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{startYear}, 'YYYY'), (LEVEL - 1) * 12), 'YYYY')
TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + LEVEL - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AS chart_label FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <=
TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
12
TO_NUMBER(#{endYear}) - TO_NUMBER(#{startYear}) + 1
TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
) SELECT ds.chart_label,
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN al.HOMEPAGE_TYPE = 1 AND (#{homepage_id} IS NULL OR #{homepage_id} = 'ALL' OR al.HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS homepage_chart_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN al.HOMEPAGE_TYPE = 2 AND (#{homepage_id} IS NULL OR #{homepage_id} = 'ALL' OR al.HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS search_chart_count
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN al.HOMEPAGE_TYPE = 1 AND (#{homepage_id} IS NULL OR #{homepage_id} = 'ALL' OR al.HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS homepage_chart_count, NVL(SUM(0), 0) AS search_chart_count
NVL(SUM(0), 0) AS homepage_chart_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN al.HOMEPAGE_TYPE = 2 AND (#{homepage_id} IS NULL OR #{homepage_id} = 'ALL' OR al.HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS search_chart_count
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN al.HOMEPAGE_TYPE = 1 AND (#{homepage_id} IS NULL OR #{homepage_id} = 'ALL' OR al.HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS homepage_chart_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN al.HOMEPAGE_TYPE = 2 AND (#{homepage_id} IS NULL OR #{homepage_id} = 'ALL' OR al.HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS search_chart_count
FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN AUTHENTICATION_LOG al ON (
TRUNC(al.ADD_DATE) = TO_DATE(ds.chart_label, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(al.ADD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') = ds.chart_label
TO_CHAR(al.ADD_DATE, 'YYYY') = ds.chart_label
TO_CHAR(al.ADD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = ds.chart_label
) GROUP BY ds.chart_label ORDER BY ds.chart_label
